annotations.title: Message a seller about a listing

description:
Message the seller of a listing for the person you act for: a question, an offer in VND, or both. Use it when the person wants to ask about or bid on a listing found with search_listings; it opens their conversation about the listing, or continues the one they already have with that seller.

Everything you send is shown to the other person starting with "🤖 AI:", and an offer you make binds the person you act for if it is accepted, so offer only what they agreed to. Never ask for a deposit or a payment: people pay each other directly, never through eno or an agent. Refused with a reason code: `not_negotiable` (an offer on a fixed-price listing), `contact_details` (phone numbers, emails, outside links or account numbers), `not_available_to_agents` (a teacher profile, or a listing with no seller to message) and `rate_limited` (10 new conversations a day).

Returns the `conversation_id`, whether it was `created` just now, and its `app_url`; get_conversation then reads the seller's reply.

listing_id.description: The listing to ask about: its id (such as `cmh0q2x8f0001...`), from search_listings or the end of its page address

message.description: What to tell or ask the seller, in the person's words, e.g. "Is it still available? I can pick it up on Saturday"

offer_amount.description: The price the person offers, in Vietnamese đồng, e.g. 3500000 for 3.5 million. Leave it out to send only the message

name: contact_seller

app_url.description: The conversation's page in the eno app, a full https URL, where the person can read the seller's reply and take over

conversation_id.description: The conversation's id: get_conversation reads the seller's reply, send_message continues it

created.description: true when this started a new conversation; false when it continued the one the person already had with this seller
